source: ICE Futures U.S. Rulebook, Chapter 8 Coffee "C" (Appendix IV Schedules C-2/C-3, Appendix V, Appendix VIII), read 2026-11-17 (re-checked same day for the March 2026 / May 2027 schedules); earlier values from the NYBOT Coffee C rules and ICE notices listed in rule_changes.csv
units: points = 1/100 cent per lb; negative = discount to the futures price

origin_diff_versions.basis_note: origins not listed are not deliverable

origin_diff_versions.rule: Schedule C-2 amended Dec 9 2010: Brazil added
Schedule C-2 amended Feb 27 2014: Colombia +400, Brazil -600; Burundi/Rwanda -100 as in the rulebook's schedule for contracts before March 2026 (date of the earlier -300 to -100 change not verified)
Schedule C-2 'Effective with the March 2026 contract' (amended by the Board Dec 20 2023, eff. Feb 12 2024; ICE notice Jan 16 2024): Colombia, Costa Rica, Kenya +1000; Guatemala +500
Schedule C-2 'Effective with the May 2027 contract' (amended Mar 27 2025, eff. Apr 15 2025; Submission 25-51): Vietnam added at -600, premiums unchanged from March 2026

port_diff_versions.rule: Schedule C-3 (NYBOT, March 2005 and later); Virginia added at basis Jul 29 2014
Schedule C-3 amended Mar 23 2017, May 2019 delivery and later (current)

age_discount_versions.rule: Appendix V items (1)-(12), March 2013 and later (current)

age_discount_note: Days run from the Certificate of Grade date to delivery; each band = base pts at band start + step pts per additional 30 days or part. No grandfathering by grading date: the schedule in force for the delivery month applies to every lot. Before Dec 1 2023 a de-certified lot could be re-graded and get a new certificate date.

weight_allowance.note: % of Weight Note weight x invoice price, months counted from weighing to delivery

oca.note: NY average load-out rate minus delivering warehouse load-out rate (per bag)

imperfection_pts.note: not applied: grading results do not publish imperfection counts per lot

origin_diff_note: Date check (2026-11-17): the rulebook prints each 'Effective with ...' line between schedules; with the amendment notes (Dec 20 2023 -> March 2026; Mar 27 2025 -> May 2027), ICE's Jan 16 2024 notice and ICE's product specification page (premiums listed as current, only Vietnam 'commencing with the May 2027 expiry'), the premiums apply from March 2026 and May 2027 adds only Vietnam.
